```{r cox-baseline}
cox_fit_ds <- function(d) {
  fit <- coxph(COX_FORMULAS[[d]], data = prepared[[d]])
  s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  tibble(dataset = d, variable = rownames(s),
         beta = s[, "coef"], se = s[, "se(coef)"],
         z = s[, "z"], p_value = s[, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}
cox_base <- map_dfr(DATASETS, cox_fit_ds)

canon <- read.csv(file.path(prep_dir, "baseline_cox_results.csv")) %>%
  select(dataset, variable, beta_canon = beta, se_canon = se, p_canon = p_value)

cmp_canon <- cox_base %>%
  inner_join(canon, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(d_beta = abs(beta - beta_canon), d_se = abs(se - se_canon), d_p = abs(p_value - p_canon))

canon_summary <- cmp_canon %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(n_matched = n(), max_d_beta = max(d_beta), max_d_p = max(d_p), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(n_canon = as.integer(table(canon$dataset)[dataset]),
         n_recomputed = as.integer(table(cox_base$dataset)[dataset]))

kable(canon_summary, digits = 12,
      caption = "呼び直した Cox とカノニカルな baseline_cox_results.csv の差") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r cox-baseline-check}
tol <- 1e-10
off <- cmp_canon %>% filter(d_beta > tol)
stopifnot(nrow(off) == 1, off$dataset == "colon", off$variable == "rxLev+5FU")
cat(sprintf("突合: 一致しない係数は %d 件（%s %s のみ、差 %.2e）。§2.4 で説明する ✅\n",
            nrow(off), off$dataset, off$variable, off$d_beta))
```

```{r glm-fit-fn}
fit_discrete <- function(d, K, link = "logit", baseline = "ns") {
  data <- prepared[[d]]
  ev <- data$time[data$status == 1]
  intervals <- suppressWarnings(create_time_intervals(ev, K))
  stacked <- stack_survival_data(data, intervals)
  stacked$interval_id <- as.numeric(stacked$interval_id)
  cov_names <- setdiff(names(data), c("time", "status"))
  base_term <- if (baseline == "factor") "factor(interval_id)"
               else sprintf("splines::ns(interval_id, df = %d)", SPLINE_DF)
  fml <- as.formula(paste("y_ik ~", paste(c(base_term, cov_names), collapse = " + ")))

  warns <- character(0)
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    glm(fml, data = stacked, family = binomial(link = link)),
    warning = function(w) { warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") })

  extract_covariate_coefs(fit) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(dataset = d, K_target = as.integer(K), K_actual = nrow(intervals),
           link = link, baseline = baseline, n_rows = nrow(stacked),
           glm_converged = fit$converged, n_warn = length(warns)) %>%
    select(dataset, variable, beta, se, z, p_value, everything())
}
```

```{r glm-vs-parquet}
stopifnot(nrow(det_check) == 53, all(det_check$n_iter == 1000),
          all(det_check$sd_beta == 0), all(det_check$sd_se == 0), all(det_check$sd_p == 0))

            nrow(det_check), max(det_check$n_iter)))

fit_pipeline_inf <- function(d) {
  p3 <- perturb_discrete_phase3(prepared[[d]], CLIPPING_BOUNDS[[d]], Inf,
                                K_VALUES[[d]], COVARIATE_TYPES[[d]])
  cov_names <- setdiff(names(prepared[[d]]), c("time", "status"))
  extract_covariate_coefs(fit_discrete_cox(p3$stacked_data, cov_names, spline_df = SPLINE_DF)) %>%
    as_tibble() %>% mutate(dataset = d)
}

pipe_base <- map_dfr(DATASETS, fit_pipeline_inf)

if (HAS_ORIGINAL_ARM) {
repro <- pipe_base %>%
  select(dataset, variable, beta, se, p_value) %>%
  inner_join(p3_inf %>% distinct(dataset, variable, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
               select(dataset, variable, beta_pq = beta, se_pq = se, p_pq = p_value),
             by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(d_beta = abs(beta - beta_pq), d_se = abs(se - se_pq), d_p = abs(p_value - p_pq))

stopifnot(nrow(repro) == 53,
          max(repro$d_beta) < 1e-12, max(repro$d_se) < 1e-12, max(repro$d_p) < 1e-12)
cat(sprintf("再現: シミュレーション経路の直接適合が parquet の ε=∞ 行 %d 係数すべてと一致（最大差 β %.2e / SE %.2e / p %.2e）✅\n",
            nrow(repro), max(repro$d_beta), max(repro$d_se), max(repro$d_p)))
}
```

```{r clipping-offset}
glm_base <- map_dfr(DATASETS, ~ fit_discrete(.x, K_VALUES[[.x]], "logit", "ns"))

clip_offset <- glm_base %>%
  select(dataset, variable, beta, se, p_value) %>%
  inner_join(pipe_base %>% select(dataset, variable, beta_pipe = beta,
                                  se_pipe = se, p_pipe = p_value),
             by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(d_beta_rel = abs(beta - beta_pipe) / pmax(abs(beta_pipe), .Machine$double.eps),
         d_p = abs(p_value - p_pipe),
         flip = (p_value < ALPHA) != (p_pipe < ALPHA))

kable(clip_offset %>% group_by(dataset) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), max_rel_dbeta = max(d_beta_rel), max_dp = max(d_p),
                  n_decision_flip = sum(flip), .groups = "drop"),
      digits = 12, caption = "クリッピングなし（ラダー）とパイプライン経路の差") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

stopifnot(max(clip_offset$d_beta_rel) < 1e-5, !any(clip_offset$flip))
cat(sprintf("差は β の相対で最大 %.2e、p で最大 %.2e、有意性が変わる係数は %d 件 ✅\n",
            max(clip_offset$d_beta_rel), max(clip_offset$d_p), sum(clip_offset$flip)))

zero_ds <- clip_offset %>% group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(all_exact = max(d_beta_rel) == 0, .groups = "drop")
kable(zero_ds, caption = "クリッピングの影響を受けるデータセット") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(sort(zero_ds$dataset[!zero_ds$all_exact]), "pbc"))
n_clipped <- sum(prepared$pbc$age < CLIPPING_BOUNDS$pbc$age[1] |
                 prepared$pbc$age > CLIPPING_BOUNDS$pbc$age[2])
cat(sprintf("影響を受けるのは pbc のみ。境界の外に出る観測は %d 件、最大ずれ %.4f 歳 ✅\n",
            n_clipped,
            max(abs(pmin(pmax(prepared$pbc$age, CLIPPING_BOUNDS$pbc$age[1]),
                         CLIPPING_BOUNDS$pbc$age[2]) - prepared$pbc$age))))
```

```{r reference-levels-paths, eval=HAS_ORIGINAL_ARM}
rx_names_of <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_parquet(path, col_select = c("dataset", "variable", "epsilon")) %>%
    filter(dataset == "colon", grepl("^rx", variable)) %>%
    mutate(eps_grp = ifelse(is.infinite(epsilon), "Inf", "finite")) %>%
    distinct(eps_grp, variable) %>%
    group_by(eps_grp) %>%
    summarise(vars = paste(sort(variable), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")
}
paths <- c(
  `インサンプル Phase 1` = "phase1_covariates/all_phase1_results.parquet",
  `インサンプル Phase 2` = "phase2_full_input/all_phase2_results.parquet",
  `インサンプル Phase 3` = "phase3_discrete/all_phase3_results.parquet",
  `train/test Phase 1`   = "traintest/all_phase1_traintest.parquet",
  `train/test Phase 2`   = "traintest/all_phase2_traintest.parquet",
  `train/test Phase 3`   = "traintest/all_phase3_traintest.parquet",
  `train/test 出力摂動`  = "traintest/all_output_dfbeta_traintest.parquet",
  `インサンプル 出力摂動 (dfbeta)` = "output_perturbation/output_perturbation_dfbeta_all.parquet",
  `インサンプル 出力摂動 (std)`    = "output_perturbation/output_perturbation_std_all.parquet"
)
ref_paths <- map_dfr(names(paths), function(nm) {
  r <- rx_names_of(file.path(sim_dir, paths[[nm]]))
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
  pick <- function(g) { v <- r$vars[r$eps_grp == g]; if (length(v) == 1L) v else NA_character_ }
  tibble(経路 = nm, `ε=∞ の係数名` = pick("Inf"), `有限 ε の係数名` = pick("finite"))
})
kable(ref_paths, caption = "colon `rx` の係数名（= 参照レベル）を成果物から直接読んだもの") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

tt_phase <- ref_paths %>% filter(grepl("^train/test Phase", 経路))
tt_out   <- ref_paths %>% filter(grepl("^train/test 出力摂動", 経路))
ins      <- ref_paths %>% filter(grepl("^インサンプル Phase", 経路))
ins_out  <- ref_paths %>% filter(grepl("^インサンプル 出力摂動", 経路))
stopifnot(
  nrow(ref_paths) == 9,
  nrow(tt_phase) == 3, nrow(tt_out) == 1, nrow(ins) == 3, nrow(ins_out) == 2,
  all(tt_phase$`ε=∞ の係数名` == "rxLev, rxLev+5FU"),
  all(tt_phase$`有限 ε の係数名` == "rxLev+5FU, rxObs"),
  tt_out$`ε=∞ の係数名` == tt_out$`有限 ε の係数名`,
  tt_out$`ε=∞ の係数名` == "rxLev, rxLev+5FU",
  all(ins$`ε=∞ の係数名` == ins$`有限 ε の係数名`),
  all(ins$`ε=∞ の係数名` == "rxLev+5FU, rxObs"),
  all(ins_out$`ε=∞ の係数名` == ins_out$`有限 ε の係数名`),
  all(ins_out$`ε=∞ の係数名` == "rxLev+5FU, rxObs")
)
cat(sprintf(paste0("経路別の参照レベル（%d 経路）: train/test Phase 1-3 のみ ε で係数名が変わる。",
                   "インサンプルは Phase 1-3・出力摂動とも全 ε で rxObs 基準 ✅\n"), nrow(ref_paths)))
```

```{r reference-levels-mechanism}
source(file.path(project_dir, "main/03_simulation/R/data_split.R"))

sp <- stratified_train_test_split(prepared$colon, test_ratio = 0.3, seed = SPLIT_BASE_SEED + 1L)
tr <- set_reference_levels(sp$train, "colon")
stopifnot(is.factor(tr$rx), levels(tr$rx)[1] == "Obs")

mech <- map_dfr(c(Inf, 10), function(e) {
  set.seed(42)
  pd <- perturb_covariates_phase1_fast(tr, CLIPPING_BOUNDS$colon, e, COVARIATE_TYPES$colon,
                                       preserve_factor_levels = FALSE)
  fit <- coxph(COX_FORMULAS$colon, data = pd)
  tibble(epsilon = ifelse(is.infinite(e), "Inf", as.character(e)),
         クラス = class(pd$rx)[1],
         水準順 = paste(if (is.factor(pd$rx)) levels(pd$rx) else sort(unique(as.character(pd$rx))),
                        collapse = ","),
         係数名 = paste(grep("^rx", names(coef(fit)), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "))
})
kable(mech, caption = "`dp_rr_categorical_vec()` が factor 水準を落とす（colon `rx`）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
stopifnot(mech$クラス[mech$epsilon == "Inf"] == "factor",
          mech$クラス[mech$epsilon == "10"] == "character",
          mech$係数名[mech$epsilon == "Inf"] == "rxLev, rxLev+5FU",
          mech$係数名[mech$epsilon == "10"] == "rxLev+5FU, rxObs")
cat("原因: ε=∞ は factor のまま、有限 ε は character に落ちて参照が Lev に戻る ✅\n")

mech_fixed <- map_dfr(c(Inf, 10), function(e) {
  set.seed(42)
  pd <- perturb_covariates_phase1_fast(tr, CLIPPING_BOUNDS$colon, e, COVARIATE_TYPES$colon)
  fit <- coxph(COX_FORMULAS$colon, data = pd)
  tibble(epsilon = ifelse(is.infinite(e), "Inf", as.character(e)),
         クラス = class(pd$rx)[1],
         水準順 = paste(levels(pd$rx), collapse = ","),
         係数名 = paste(grep("^rx", names(coef(fit)), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "))
})
kable(mech_fixed, caption = "現行の既定（`preserve_factor_levels = TRUE`）では ε によらず参照が `Obs`") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(mech_fixed$クラス == "factor"),
          all(mech_fixed$係数名 == "rxLev, rxLev+5FU"),
          identical(mech$水準順[mech$epsilon == "Inf"], mech_fixed$水準順[mech_fixed$epsilon == "Inf"]))
cat("現行の既定では有限 ε でも factor のまま返り、参照は `Obs` に留まる ✅\n")

mk_ref <- function(ref) {
  d <- prepared$colon
  d$rx <- factor(as.character(d$rx), levels = c(ref, setdiff(c("Obs", "Lev", "Lev+5FU"), ref)))
  coxph(COX_FORMULAS$colon, data = d)
}
f_obs <- mk_ref("Obs"); f_lev <- mk_ref("Lev")
non_rx <- grep("^rx", names(coef(f_obs)), value = TRUE, invert = TRUE)
invariance <- tibble(
  量 = c("rx 以外の 10 係数の最大差", "対数尤度の差", "concordance の差"),
  差 = c(max(abs(coef(f_obs)[non_rx] - coef(f_lev)[non_rx])),
         abs(f_obs$loglik[2] - f_lev$loglik[2]),
         abs(concordance(f_obs)$concordance - concordance(f_lev)$concordance))
)
kable(invariance, digits = 20, caption = "参照レベルを変えたときの当てはめ量の差") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
stopifnot(length(non_rx) == 10, invariance$差[1] < 1e-12,
          invariance$差[2] < 1e-9, invariance$差[3] == 0)
cat(sprintf("再パラメータ化の不変性: 他係数 %.2e / 対数尤度 %.2e / concordance %.0f ✅\n",
            invariance$差[1], invariance$差[2], invariance$差[3]))

rx_contrasts <- bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(summary(f_obs)$coefficients)[grep("^rx", names(coef(f_obs))), ] %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("係数") %>% mutate(参照 = "Obs"),
  as.data.frame(summary(f_lev)$coefficients)[grep("^rx", names(coef(f_lev))), ] %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("係数") %>% mutate(参照 = "Lev")
) %>% select(参照, 係数, beta = coef, se = `se(coef)`, p = `Pr(>|z|)`)
kable(rx_contrasts, digits = 6, caption = "2 つの対比（Levamisole 単剤はほぼ無効なので差は小さい）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r discordance-table}
discord <- cox_base %>%
  rename(beta_cox = beta, se_cox = se, z_cox = z, p_cox = p_value) %>%
  inner_join(glm_base %>% select(dataset, variable, beta_glm = beta, se_glm = se,
                                 z_glm = z, p_glm = p_value, K_actual),
             by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(sig_cox = p_cox < ALPHA,
         sig_glm = p_glm < ALPHA,
         discordant = sig_cox != sig_glm,
         direction = case_when(sig_cox & !sig_glm ~ "Cox 有意 → GLM 非有意（LSR 側）",
                               !sig_cox & sig_glm ~ "Cox 非有意 → GLM 有意（FPR 側）",
                               TRUE ~ "一致"),
         dlog_z = log(abs(z_glm)) - log(abs(z_cox)),
         z_ratio = abs(z_glm) / abs(z_cox)) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASETS)) %>%
  arrange(dataset, variable)

summ <- discord %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(n_coef = n(), n_discordant = sum(discordant),
            median_z_ratio = median(z_ratio),
            min_z_ratio = min(z_ratio), max_z_ratio = max(z_ratio), .groups = "drop")
kable(summ, digits = 3, caption = "α=0.05 での乖離係数数と |z| 比の分布") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

kable(discord %>% filter(discordant) %>%
        select(dataset, variable, beta_cox, se_cox, p_cox, beta_glm, se_glm, p_glm,
               z_ratio, direction),
      digits = 5, caption = "乖離した係数（α=0.05）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r exclusion-check}
PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE <- data.frame(dataset = c("lung", "flchain"),
                                 variable = c("ph.karno", "sample.yr"))
PHASE3_FPR_EXCLUDE <- data.frame(dataset = "flchain", variable = "kappa")
expected <- rbind(PHASE3_LSR_EXCLUDE, PHASE3_FPR_EXCLUDE) %>%
  arrange(dataset, variable) %>% mutate(key = paste(dataset, variable))

found <- discord %>% filter(discordant) %>%
  transmute(key = paste(dataset, variable)) %>% arrange(key)

stopifnot(setequal(found$key, expected$key), nrow(found) == 3)
cat(sprintf("除外規約との突合: 独立に再判定した乖離集合 {%s} が evaluation.Rmd のハードコード値と完全一致 ✅\n",
            paste(sort(found$key), collapse = ", ")))

stopifnot(setequal(found$key, paste(TARGETS$dataset, TARGETS$variable)))
cat("実験 H の診断対象 3 変数とも一致 ✅\n")

dropped <- tibble(
  dataset  = c("pbc", "colon"),
  var_cox  = c("sexf", "rxLev"),
  var_glm  = c("sexm", "rxObs")) %>%
  mutate(p_cox = map2_dbl(dataset, var_cox, ~ canon$p_canon[canon$dataset == .x & canon$variable == .y]),
         p_glm = map2_dbl(dataset, var_glm, ~ glm_base$p_value[glm_base$dataset == .x & glm_base$variable == .y]),
         sig_cox = p_cox < ALPHA, sig_glm = p_glm < ALPHA, discordant = sig_cox != sig_glm)
kable(dropped, digits = 5,
      caption = "既存規約で落とされる 2 係数（参照レベル不一致）— どちらの側でも非有意") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
stopifnot(!any(dropped$discordant))
cat("落とされる 2 係数はいずれも両側で非有意であり、乖離集合は 51 係数扱いでも 53 係数扱いでも 3 件で変わらない ✅\n")
```

```{r ladder}
cox_coarsened <- function(d, K, ties = "efron") {
  data <- prepared[[d]]
  ev <- data$time[data$status == 1]
  intervals <- suppressWarnings(create_time_intervals(ev, K))
  k_star <- if (nrow(intervals) > 1)
    findInterval(data$time, intervals$upper[-nrow(intervals)], left.open = TRUE) + 1L
  else rep(1L, nrow(data))
  d2 <- data; d2$time <- k_star
  warns <- character(0)
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    coxph(COX_FORMULAS[[d]], data = d2, ties = ties),
    warning = function(w) { warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") })
  s <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  tibble(dataset = d, variable = rownames(s), beta = s[, "coef"], se = s[, "se(coef)"],
         z = s[, "z"], p_value = s[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
         K_target = as.integer(K), K_actual = nrow(intervals),
         glm_converged = TRUE, n_warn = length(warns))
}

LADDER_STEPS <- tibble::tribble(
  ~step, ~model_id,                        ~label,
  1L,    "A_cox",                          "A. Cox（実時間）",
  2L,    "Ap_cox_coarsened",               "A'. Cox（時間を k* に粗視化）",
  3L,    "B_cloglog_factor",               "B. 離散時間 cloglog + factor(k)",
  4L,    "C_logit_factor",                 "C. 離散時間 logit + factor(k)",
  5L,    "D_logit_ns",                     "D. 離散時間 logit + ns(k, df=3) = Phase 3"
)

ladder_ds <- c("lung", "flchain")

ladder <- map_dfr(ladder_ds, function(d) {
  K <- K_VALUES[[d]]
  bind_rows(
    cox_base %>% filter(dataset == d) %>% mutate(model_id = "A_cox", K_actual = NA_integer_),
    cox_coarsened(d, K) %>% mutate(model_id = "Ap_cox_coarsened") %>% select(-K_target),
    fit_discrete(d, K, "cloglog", "factor") %>% mutate(model_id = "B_cloglog_factor") %>%
      select(dataset, variable, beta, se, z, p_value, K_actual, model_id),
    fit_discrete(d, K, "logit", "factor") %>% mutate(model_id = "C_logit_factor") %>%
      select(dataset, variable, beta, se, z, p_value, K_actual, model_id),
    fit_discrete(d, K, "logit", "ns") %>% mutate(model_id = "D_logit_ns") %>%
      select(dataset, variable, beta, se, z, p_value, K_actual, model_id)
  ) %>% mutate(K_base = as.integer(K))
}) %>%
  left_join(LADDER_STEPS, by = "model_id") %>%
  mutate(sig = p_value < ALPHA) %>%
  arrange(dataset, variable, step)

ladder_D <- ladder %>% filter(model_id == "D_logit_ns") %>% select(dataset, variable, beta, se, p_value)
if (HAS_ORIGINAL_ARM) {
chk_D <- ladder_D %>% inner_join(repro %>% select(dataset, variable, beta_pq, se_pq, p_pq),
                                 by = c("dataset", "variable"))
stopifnot(nrow(chk_D) == 14, max(abs(chk_D$beta - chk_D$beta_pq)) == 0,
          max(abs(chk_D$se - chk_D$se_pq)) == 0, max(abs(chk_D$p_value - chk_D$p_pq)) == 0)
cat(sprintf("ラダー段 D の検査: lung・flchain の %d 係数すべてが Phase 3 の ε=∞ 行と厳密に一致 ✅\n", nrow(chk_D)))
}
```

```{r ladder-decomp}
STEP_MEANING <- c(
  "D→C" = "ベースラインハザードの平滑化（ns df=3 → 飽和）",
  "C→B" = "リンク関数（logit → cloglog）= 分類 (c)",
  "B→A'" = "推定量（グループ化二項尤度 → Cox 部分尤度）※整合性確認",
  "A'→A" = "時間の離散化 = 分類 (b)"
)

decomp <- ladder %>%
  select(dataset, variable, model_id, z) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model_id, values_from = z) %>%
  mutate(
    `D→C`  = log(abs(C_logit_factor))   - log(abs(D_logit_ns)),
    `C→B`  = log(abs(B_cloglog_factor)) - log(abs(C_logit_factor)),
    `B→A'` = log(abs(Ap_cox_coarsened)) - log(abs(B_cloglog_factor)),
    `A'→A` = log(abs(A_cox))            - log(abs(Ap_cox_coarsened)),
    total  = log(abs(A_cox))            - log(abs(D_logit_ns)),
    sum_steps = `D→C` + `C→B` + `B→A'` + `A'→A`
  )

stopifnot(max(abs(decomp$total - decomp$sum_steps)) < 1e-12)
cat(sprintf("加法性の検査: 4 段の和と全体差の最大乖離 %.2e（厳密に一致）✅\n",
            max(abs(decomp$total - decomp$sum_steps))))

decomp_tgt <- decomp %>% semi_join(TARGETS, by = c("dataset", "variable"))

decomp_tgt %>%
  transmute(dataset, variable,
            `z (Phase 3)` = D_logit_ns, `z (Cox)` = A_cox,
            `D→C` , `C→B`, `B→A'`, `A'→A`, `合計` = total,
            `支配的な段` = c("D→C", "C→B", "B→A'", "A'→A")[
              apply(abs(cbind(`D→C`, `C→B`, `B→A'`, `A'→A`)), 1, which.max)]) %>%
  kable(digits = 4, caption = "log|z| の段別分解（正の値 = その段を戻すと |z| が増える）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

decomp_pct <- decomp_tgt %>%
  transmute(dataset, variable,
            across(c(`D→C`, `C→B`, `B→A'`, `A'→A`), ~ 100 * (exp(.x) - 1),
                   .names = "{.col} (%)"),
            `合計 (%)` = 100 * (exp(total) - 1))
kable(decomp_pct, digits = 1, caption = "各段が |z| を何 % 動かすか") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r hazard-magnitude}
hazard_profile <- map_dfr(DATASETS, function(d) {
  data <- prepared[[d]]
  ev <- data$time[data$status == 1]
  intervals <- suppressWarnings(create_time_intervals(ev, K_VALUES[[d]]))
  st <- stack_survival_data(data, intervals)
  st$interval_id <- as.numeric(st$interval_id)
  cov_names <- setdiff(names(data), c("time", "status"))
  fit <- glm(as.formula(paste("y_ik ~ factor(interval_id) +", paste(cov_names, collapse = " + "))),
             data = st, family = binomial(link = "cloglog"))
  h <- fitted(fit)
  emp <- st %>% group_by(interval_id) %>% summarise(h = sum(y_ik) / n(), .groups = "drop")
  tibble(dataset = d, K = nrow(intervals), n = nrow(data), events = sum(data$status),
         h_emp_med = median(emp$h), h_emp_max = max(emp$h),
         h_fit_med = median(h), h_fit_p90 = quantile(h, 0.9), h_fit_max = max(h),
         frac_h_gt_10pct = mean(h > 0.1))
})
kable(hazard_profile, digits = 4,
      caption = "K = K_VALUES における区間ハザードの大きさ（cloglog + 飽和ベースライン）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r hazard-leverage}
lev <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(TARGETS)), function(i) {
  d <- TARGETS$dataset[i]; v <- TARGETS$variable[i]
  data <- prepared[[d]]
  ev <- data$time[data$status == 1]
  intervals <- suppressWarnings(create_time_intervals(ev, K_VALUES[[d]]))
  st <- stack_survival_data(data, intervals)
  st$interval_id <- as.numeric(st$interval_id)
  cov_names <- setdiff(names(data), c("time", "status"))
  fit <- glm(as.formula(paste("y_ik ~ factor(interval_id) +", paste(cov_names, collapse = " + "))),
             data = st, family = binomial(link = "cloglog"))
  st$h <- fitted(fit)
  q9 <- quantile(data[[v]], 0.9)
  top <- st[[v]] >= q9
  stopifnot(any(top), any(!top))
  tibble(dataset = d, variable = v, q90 = as.numeric(q9),
         n_rows_top10 = sum(top),
         h_mean_top10 = mean(st$h[top]), h_max_top10 = max(st$h[top]),
         h_mean_rest = mean(st$h[!top]))
})
kable(lev, digits = 4, caption = "共変量上位 10% の行におけるフィットハザード") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r ksweep, cache=FALSE}
d_unique <- sapply(DATASETS, function(d)
  length(unique(prepared[[d]]$time[prepared[[d]]$status == 1])))

K_MAX_CAP <- 100L

k_grid_for <- function(d) {
  base <- K_VALUES[[d]]
  g <- c(4L, 6L, base - 2L, base, base + 2L, 20L, 30L, 50L, 75L, 100L)
  g <- g[g >= 2L]
  sort(unique(pmin(g, min(K_MAX_CAP, d_unique[[d]]))))
}

SPECS <- tibble::tribble(
  ~model_id,            ~link,     ~baseline,
  "D_logit_ns",         "logit",   "ns",
  "B_cloglog_factor",   "cloglog", "factor",
  "C_logit_factor",     "logit",   "factor"
)

t0 <- Sys.time()
ksweep <- map_dfr(DATASETS, function(d) {
  map_dfr(k_grid_for(d), function(K) {
    map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(SPECS)), function(i)
      fit_discrete(d, K, SPECS$link[i], SPECS$baseline[i]) %>%
        mutate(model_id = SPECS$model_id[i]))
  })
}) %>%
  mutate(K_base = as.integer(unlist(K_VALUES[dataset])), sig = p_value < ALPHA)
cat(sprintf("K 掃引: %d 行 / %.1f 分\n", nrow(ksweep),
            as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))))

ksweep_cox <- map_dfr(DATASETS, function(d)
  map_dfr(k_grid_for(d), function(K) cox_coarsened(d, K))) %>%
  mutate(model_id = "Ap_cox_coarsened", K_base = as.integer(unlist(K_VALUES[dataset])),
         sig = p_value < ALPHA, link = NA_character_, baseline = NA_character_)

ksweep_all <- bind_rows(
  ksweep %>% select(dataset, variable, K_target, K_actual, model_id, link, baseline,
                    beta, se, z, p_value, sig, n_rows, glm_converged, n_warn, K_base),
  ksweep_cox %>% select(dataset, variable, K_target, K_actual, model_id, link, baseline,
                        beta, se, z, p_value, sig, glm_converged, n_warn, K_base)
) %>%
  mutate(usable = glm_converged & n_warn == 0)
```

```{r ksweep-convergence}
conv_tbl <- ksweep_all %>%
  distinct(dataset, model_id, K_actual, glm_converged, n_warn, usable) %>%
  filter(!usable) %>%
  arrange(dataset, model_id, K_actual)
if (nrow(conv_tbl) == 0) {
  cat("掃引した全条件で適合が収束した\n")
} else {
  kable(conv_tbl, caption = "収束しなかった／警告が出た適合（以降の判定から除外する）") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
}
n_cond <- nrow(distinct(ksweep_all, dataset, model_id, K_actual))
cat(sprintf("除外: %d 条件 / 全 %d 条件（%.1f%%）\n", nrow(conv_tbl), n_cond,
            100 * nrow(conv_tbl) / n_cond))

core <- ksweep_all %>%
  filter(model_id == "D_logit_ns",
         K_target == K_base - 2L | K_target == K_base | K_target == K_base + 2L)
stopifnot(nrow(core) > 0, all(core$usable))
cat(sprintf("Phase 3 の仕様（D）は K ∈ {base−2, base, base+2} の全 %d 条件で健全 ✅\n",
            nrow(distinct(core, dataset, K_actual))))

if (nrow(conv_tbl) > 0) {
  kable(conv_tbl %>% count(model_id, coarse = K_actual <= 6, name = "n_conditions"),
        caption = "除外条件の内訳（coarse = K ≤ 6）") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
}
```

```{r write-outputs}
out_files <- list(

  phase3_discordance_refinvariance = invariance %>%
    rename(quantity = 量, difference = 差),
  phase3_discordance_boundary = boundary %>% mutate(dataset = as.character(dataset))
)

out_files <- Filter(Negate(is.null), out_files)
out_csv  <- paste0(names(out_files), ".csv")
existing <- list.files(eval_dir)
stopifnot(all(startsWith(names(out_files), "phase3_discordance_")))
stopifnot(length(intersect(out_csv, setdiff(existing, out_csv))) == 0)
cat("出力名の検査: 名前空間 OK / 既存ファイルとの衝突 0 件 ✅\n")

iwalk(out_files, function(df, nm) {
  path <- file.path(eval_dir, paste0(nm, ".csv"))
  write.csv(df, path, row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("%-38s %5d 行\n", basename(path), nrow(df)))
})
```

```{r conclusion}
tibble(
  項目 = c(
    "乖離係数数（α=0.05、53 係数中）",
    "既存の除外規約との一致",
    "flchain kappa の主因",
    "lung ph.karno の主因",
    "flchain sample.yr の主因",
    "K を変えたときの挙動（対象 3 変数）",
    "有限 ε の再実行の要否"
  ),
  結果 = c(
    sprintf("%d 件（%s）。|z| 比の中央値は %.3f で、モデル変更の影響は全体としては小さい",
            sum(discord$discordant),
            paste(paste(discord$dataset[discord$discordant], discord$variable[discord$discordant]),
                  collapse = " / "),
            median(discord$z_ratio)),
    "独立に再判定した集合が evaluation.Rmd のハードコード値と完全一致（§3.2）",
    sprintf("リンク関数 %s / 離散化 %s。Cox の p は α の %.2f 倍で、%.1f%% の |z| 変化で判定が反転する",
            pc(get_step("flchain", "kappa", "C→B")), pc(get_step("flchain", "kappa", "A'→A")),
            boundary$p_over_alpha[boundary$dataset == "flchain" & boundary$variable == "kappa"],
            100 * boundary$margin_needed[boundary$dataset == "flchain" & boundary$variable == "kappa"]),
    sprintf("リンク関数 %s / 離散化 %s。Cox の p は α の %.2f 倍",
            pc(get_step("lung", "ph.karno", "C→B")), pc(get_step("lung", "ph.karno", "A'→A")),
            boundary$p_over_alpha[boundary$dataset == "lung" & boundary$variable == "ph.karno"]),
    sprintf("離散化 %s が支配的。リンクは %s にすぎず、Cox の p は α の %.3f 倍で境界から遠い",
            pc(get_step("flchain", "sample.yr", "A'→A")), pc(get_step("flchain", "sample.yr", "C→B")),
            boundary$p_over_alpha[boundary$dataset == "flchain" & boundary$variable == "sample.yr"]),
    sprintf("%s", paste(sprintf("%s %s: %s", resolution$dataset, resolution$variable,
                                ifelse(resolution$n_resolved > 0,
                                       sprintf("K = %s で解消", resolution$K_resolved),
                                       "試した全 K で乖離が残る")), collapse = " / ")),
    "不要。ε=∞ は決定的（1,000 反復の SD が厳密に 0、§2.2）"
  )
) %>%
  kable(caption = "実験 H の結果サマリー") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```
